notes: Every exception must name a package, a reason, a mitigation, and an expiry date. The audit script fails on any unlisted high/critical advisory and on expired exceptions.

exceptions.reason: Fix requires Zod 4, a breaking change across every schema and the MCP SDK integration. The advisory concerns memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections.
exceptions.mitigation: Every request body is capped at 200 KB (API) or 1 MB (MCP express.json). Array and string lengths are explicitly bounded in each schema. Tool output is capped at 2 MB. Revisit when upgrading to Zod 4.

exceptions.reason: Tailwind 3 is a build-time dependency only. The advisory is a CPU-exhaustion issue in selector parsing, not an input path in this application.
exceptions.mitigation: No user or repository content reaches Tailwind. Tailwind 4 is a separate migration.

exceptions.reason: Build-time CSS processing only; no runtime exposure.
Quadratic complexity parsing flat selectors. Only build-time CSS is parsed.
exceptions.mitigation: No untrusted CSS is processed. Tracked for the Tailwind 4 migration.
